usageNotes: Triggers a bulk start of all VMs and containers on the specified node; by default only guests with onboot=1 are started unless force=true is passed. The operation is asynchronous — the return value is a task UPID that must be polled via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to confirm completion. Requires VM.PowerMgmt on / or on each individual /vms/<ID> if the vms parameter is used.

examples.summary: Start all onboot-enabled VMs on pve1, limiting to 4 concurrent start tasks

tips: Omit 'vms' to target all eligible guests on the node; supply a comma-separated VMID list (e.g. '100,101,105') to limit scope.
Set force=true during post-maintenance boot when some guests intentionally have onboot=0 but still need to come up.
max-workers defaults to the datacenter.cfg setting or CPU threads capped at 8; lower it on resource-constrained nodes to avoid boot storms.
Poll the returned UPID against GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to detect failures for individual guests — the bulk task succeeds even if some guests fail to start.
